# RLS audit of migration 0040 (T-057)

Fresh RLS-auditor subagent. `bun run test:db`: 157 passed before; with its file 176 passed + 3 expected failures (the gaps).

| Object                  | anon         | member            | admin                     | other account  | left                       |
| ----------------------- | ------------ | ----------------- | ------------------------- | -------------- | -------------------------- |
| payment_claims select   | denied       | account's claims  | same                      | 0 rows         | 0 rows                     |
| payment_claims write    | denied       | denied            | denied                    | denied         | denied                     |
| claim_payment           | denied       | own debts         | own debts                 | not_a_member   | not_a_member               |
| decide_payment_claim    | denied       | as payee          | any claim (G2: incl. own) | not_a_member   | not_a_member               |
| close_settled_claims    | not callable | via split updates | same                      | —              | —                          |
| email_lang              | denied       | denied            | denied                    | denied         | denied (service role only) |
| update_property_details | denied       | admin required    | allowed                   | admin required | admin required             |
| preferred_lang          | denied       | own row           | own row                   | own row        | own row                    |

**Gaps.** G1 (Medium) confirming settled shares added after the claim. G2 (Low) an admin could confirm a claim where they are the payer. G3 (Low) a claim toward a member who left was accepted.

**Probes that held:** claims toward another account or self; deciding someone else's claim; amount not settable; per-expense claim for another cottage/account/payer; the debtor can't mark own share paid; other account's claims untouched; names don't leak via notify_enqueue.

**Not proven / out of scope:** older policies let any member create an expense "paid by" someone else or a split on anyone (predates 0040; can skew a net claim) — ticket O-row; PGlite, not Supabase; concurrent decisions (row lock in place).

## Fixes

G1: claims store `split_ids` at claim time; confirming marks exactly those; the closing trigger closes a claim when all its shares are paid. G2: `me.id = c.from_member_id` refused. G3: `left_at is null` required for the payee. The three tests now pass as normal tests.
